design_vision: Award-worthy, vibrant, and bright editorial design for Kathaa (कथा). Blends Sydney harbour dusk warmth with rich Devanagari typography, golden thread micro-interactions, Framer Motion masked reveals, and bilingual chapter eyebrows that mirror the hero masthead.
original_problem_statement: Bilingual Eyebrows: Give each chapter heading a small Devanagari eyebrow above the English, like the masthead does. also lets change the design language a little bit. make the website bit more vibrant. more bright.
user_choices: Small Devanagari eyebrows above English chapter headings matching masthead; a slightly changed, more vibrant and bright design language with precise light/ivory and rich dark surface alternating.

vibrant_bright_surface_treatments.philosophy: To deliver a clearly brighter and more vibrant experience while keeping the 'a little bit' editorial aesthetic shift, we replace monolithic deep navy backgrounds with a dynamic rhythm of luminous warm ivory (#fdfbf7), lustrous dusk indigo (#121a2d), and golden radiant accents (#e5b869).

hero_prologue.surface: Lustrous Dusk Midnight (#121a2d) with radial gold & amethyst ambient glow (#e5b869, #d8beed)
hero_prologue.treatment: Hero masthead features Devanagari 'कथा' with animated golden shirorekha line draw and subtle 2.5D parallax hero float. Vibrant chrome dusk gradient text effect on the year rewind.

premise_manifesto.treatment: High contrast light section providing immediate brightness after dusk hero. Deep Charcoal ink text (#0f172a) with Deep Gold (#8f6527) chapter eyebrows and Sindoor Red (#d13824) numeral accents.

chapter_one_now_showing.surface: Deep Navy Night (#14213a) with Chrome Dusk Sheen
chapter_one_now_showing.treatment: Sticky 2000s rewind stage with glowing chrome dusk sheen text animation and vibrant media slot borders with golden ambient glow.

unfolds_horizontal_track.surface: Alternating Warm Ivory (#f9f5ec) and Deep Tide (#1a2744)
unfolds_horizontal_track.treatment: Horizontal scroll sequence transitioning from crisp light ivory panels to rich deep tide panels for high visual cadence.
unfolds_horizontal_track.text_contrast: Dynamic contrast per panel (Ink on Ivory, Ivory on Deep Tide)

standard_section.surface: Luminous Ivory (#f7f2e8) with Sindoor Red accents
standard_section.treatment: Editorial two-column grid on bright ivory background with large italicized display text.

chapters_grid.surface: Rich Tide (#1a2744) with Golden Border Glow
chapters_grid.treatment: Interactive chapter cards with subtle scale hover, gold borders, and adjacent blank-page preview card in ivory.

join_list_form.treatment: Bright conversion section with gold-underlined form fields, Sindoor Red submit highlights, and warm background.

chapter_one_page.hero: Deep Tide (#14213a) hero with vibrant harbour dusk background gradient and golden eyebrow.
chapter_one_page.story_and_artist: Luminous Warm Ivory (#f7f2e8) section with rich portrait frame borders and high-contrast typography.
chapter_one_page.on_the_water_and_evening: Rich Dusk Indigo (#121a2d) with interactive event details grid and cassette line art.
chapter_one_page.faq_and_join_list: Bright Ivory (#fdfbf7) accordion FAQ and email signup.

our_story_page.hero_held_note: Deep Dusk (#121a2d) hero featuring animated 'Held Note' text reveal and golden vertical stroke.
our_story_page.pravaha_house_and_why: Bright Ivory (#f7f2e8) background showcasing Pravaha House story and values in deep ink typography.

bilingual_eyebrows_system.design_concept: Each chapter heading features a two-tiered bilingual eyebrow that acts as a miniature version of the main hero masthead.
bilingual_eyebrows_system.top_tier_devanagari: Small Devanagari text rendered in 'Rozha One' (var(--font-deva)), font size 0.95rem, gold/deep-gold color, with an optional subtle 1px golden shirorekha underline effect.
bilingual_eyebrows_system.bottom_tier_english: Uppercase English subtitle in 'Cormorant SC' (var(--font-sc)), font size 0.75rem, letter-spacing 0.3em, tracking-widest.
bilingual_eyebrows_system.rendering_component: ChapterHead component (/app/frontend/src/components/ChapterHead.jsx) renders eyebrow_deva above eyebrow_en with Framer Motion masked reveal.

typography.devanagari_font: Rozha One, Noto Serif Devanagari, serif

Chapter_I_Premise.english: A new initiative from Pravaha House

image_urls.description: Existing imagery remains placeholders until written approval per specifications.

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll with lerp 0.08 and momentum weight
motion_and_effects.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line masked reveals and staggered word drops
motion_and_effects.bilingual_eyebrow_animation: Animate Devanagari eyebrow fade-in with 1px golden shirorekha underline draw
motion_and_effects.marquee: react-fast-marquee running subtle golden editorial excerpts in low-contrast typography
motion_and_effects.hero_parallax: Subtle 2.5D float on hero year rewind counter and masthead title

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements and key headings MUST retain data-testid attributes
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_backend_changes: Front-end SPA only; preserve forms and ticket link logic
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.content_restrictions: CRITICAL: Never use words yacht, party, charity, fundraiser, donation, or name the vessel
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high text contrast ratios (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for headers); support prefers-reduced-motion
